theorem ilk_correct (f : ℕ) (cA : Batteries.RBSet AccountAddress compare) (gbh : BlockHeader)
    (blocks : ProcessedBlocks) (σ σ₀ : AccountMap .EVM) (a s o : AccountAddress) (gp : ℕ)
    (h : BlockHeader) (d : ℕ) (bvh : List ByteArray) :
    ∃ cA' g' A', Ξ (f + 79) cA gbh blocks σ σ₀ G0 default (env a s o gp h d bvh)
      = .ok (.success (cA', σ, g', A') (UInt256.toByteArray (slot σ a ⟨2⟩)))

definitions.GemJoin.Ilk.env: call environment: codeOwner a, sender s, source o, weiValue 0, calldata 0xc5ce281e, code GemJoin.runtime, perm true (non-static), other fields universally quantified
definitions.GemJoin.Ilk.slot: (σ.find? a).option 0 (Account.lookupStorage k): EVMYulLean's SLOAD read, 0 for an absent account or key
definitions.UInt256.toByteArray: EVMYulLean (patched by 0005); GemJoin.toByteArray_eq proves it is the 32 big-endian bytes
